title: The frontend offers "Save and add another" even when the line holds a single animal; DR1 hides that button and renames it "Save and finish" for the last animal

finding.frontend: The in-card action button always reads "Save and add another" and is always rendered while the card is below its cap — src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/animal-identification/_identification-card.njk:71-76 emits it unconditionally in the not-at-maximum branch. All three species captures show it against a line of one animal: fe-animal-identification and fe-animal-identification-horse and fe-animal-identification-fish each read "Enter details for … 1 of 1" and still offer to add another. Pressing it on such a line saves the animal and the card then re-renders in its maximum-reached state, so the label promises a second animal the line cannot hold and the user finds that out only after committing the first.
finding.prototype: DR1 decides the in-card button per species panel in app/routes.js:1712-1721. When the line holds one animal the button is suppressed entirely and the user saves with the page-level Save and continue. When more than one animal remains the button reads "Save and add another", and on the last remaining animal it reads "Save and finish". The dr1-animal-identification-details capture is a two-animal line on its first animal, so it shows "Save and add another"; the one-animal and last-animal states were not photographed.
finding.difference: Drive the in-card button from the line's cap and the number of records already saved, in the card view model at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/animal-identification/card/view-model.js:84-118: no button when the cap is one, "Save and add another" while more than one animal remains, and a finish label on the last. Both strings the card would need already exist in the commodities copy file, and the submit value for the finish case is the action the page-level finish button already posts. The wording of the last-animal button has to be settled first: "Save and finish" is already this page's page-level primary button, so lifting it into the card puts two identically labelled buttons on one page. This is the button inside the species card, not the page-level save-and-return pattern.
finding.falsifiedBy: Rendering DR1's identification page for a species whose consignment-details count is 1 and seeing a save button inside the panel.
finding.verification: Opened all four rendered DOMs and the fe-animal-identification screenshot; read _identification-card.njk:71-76, animal-identification.njk:19-25, form/forms.js:66-135, animal-identification.controller.js:63-121 and app/routes.js:1710-1722. Ran the falsifier against DR1's panel builder rather than the browser: totalAnimals <= 1 sets showSaveButton false and saveButtonText null, one remaining sets "Save and finish", anything else sets "Save and add another" — the finding's account of DR1 is exact. Two claims on the frontend side did not survive and are corrected; the finding itself stands. CORRECT on the difference it names, with two supporting claims fixed — see correction.
finding.correction: Claimed that pressing "Save and add another" on a one-animal line is refused by the cardinality rule. It is not. capReachedResponse (form/forms.js:97-120) fires only when atMaxByIndex holds the card, and atMaxByIndex is built from the stored records against the cap (:66-82), so a 1-of-1 card with nothing saved yet is not at maximum: the record appends through appendLineRecords (animal-identification.controller.js:100) and the page redirects back to itself in the maximum-reached state. The refusal path is reachable only by replaying a stale form, which is exactly what the repo's own "rejects a stale add action after the animal-count cap is reached" test has to do with page.evaluate. finding.frontend is corrected to say the button saves and then strands the user, which is the real defect and a slightly different one. Claimed also that the change needs two new strings in the commodities copy file. It needs none: saveAndAddAnother is at copy.en.js:94 and saveAndFinish at :95, and saveAndFinish is already this page's page-level primary button (animal-identification.njk:19 and :25), so reusing it inside the card would put two buttons with the same label on one page. finding.difference is corrected to say so.
